MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH — TERMLY EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Reproduction? (1 mark)

   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Reproduction.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conservation of marine and freshwater environments? (1 mark)

5. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)

   B. 50 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 100 °C

6. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

7. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Nitrogen gas only

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ornamental Fish culture? (1 mark)

   B. Guess results without recording observations on Ornamental Fish culture.

   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ornamental Fish culture.

   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.

10. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Ecology and Ecosystems? (1 mark)

13. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Milk souring
   D. Ice melting to water

14. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Record keeping in aquaculture? (1 mark)

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond? (1 mark)
